description: This Java source file defines the class LoanProductToGLAccountMappingHelper, which extends ProductToGLAccountMappingHelper. It provides methods to manage GL account mappings for loan products, including saving, merging, updating, and deleting account mappings. The class handles different accounting rules (NONE, CASH_BASED, ACCRUAL_PERIODIC, ACCRUAL_UPFRONT) and includes specialized methods for processing account configurations related to loan products, charges, and payment channels.
